title: W9 re-pin left the stale hard-coded burst-ceiling message (2 = ceil_cap) while the check became per-type
evidence: testing.expectf(t, burst_ok, "no per-tick burst beyond the ceiling (2 = ceil_cap) may occur")
detail: The diff made the burst ceiling per-type (host ceil_cap 2, campus 3) but the failure message still says "2 = ceil_cap", contradicting the PR body's "per-type burst ceilings" claim and misdiagnosing any campus burst-3 failure.
recommended_fix: Update the message to the per-type ceiling, e.g. "no per-tick burst beyond the per-type ceiling (ceil_cap: host 2, campus 3) may occur".
